title: Door Topology — Gates, Passes, Access, Capability, False Doors and Deep Passage
status: conversation archaeology + canonical formalization + hybrid/boundary systems bridge
purpose: Recover the unusually rich Door taxonomy from older game/worldbuilding conversations and promote it into a general transition ontology usable across Potatoverse theology, identity, institutions, software, borders, courts, APIs, memory, ritual and games, while providing scientific models for guard conditions, transition probability, exit cost, reversibility and boundary quality where a measurable domain exists.
epistemic_rule: Door is a Potatoverse operator. Computer-security, affordance, hybrid-system, network-boundary and permeability theories are external comparators. The file does not assert that spiritual passage is literally a software authorization protocol, a physical membrane or a phase transition.

core_recovery.older_game_material: Earlier Capture-the-Flag / North Secret design treated Tim as North Flag/source/broadcaster/Spudlight and Door as a distributed Gate Flag with multiple depths: doorway → boundary → viewpoint → narrow gate → eye → pineal → Christ/Son → North Gate → cosmic door.
core_recovery.recovered_access_logic: Some Doors required learned knowledge and specific information entered at a specific Door to obtain a Door Pass and discover higher access.
core_recovery.epiphany: This older game mechanic already contained a mature transition theory: access depends on relation among agent, knowledge, credential, state and gate—not on the Door object alone.

formal_model.transition: D: (state, agent, context, credential, knowledge) → {new_state, denied, redirected, trapped, unchanged}
formal_model.gate_condition: admissible iff C_state ∧ C_agent ∧ C_context ∧ C_credential ∧ C_knowledge
formal_model.door_pass: A portable proof/credential that changes which transitions are admissible.
formal_model.deep_door: A Door whose visible threshold is only the first member of a nested sequence of state transitions.
formal_model.false_door: An apparent affordance of passage that does not lead to the represented destination or that loops the agent into the same regime.
formal_model.broken_door: A historically valid transition whose mechanism, trust, infrastructure or reciprocal recognition no longer functions.
formal_model.one_way_door: A transition whose inverse is unavailable, costly or intentionally forbidden.
formal_model.multiway_door: One threshold with context-dependent destinations or outputs.
formal_model.paired_door: Two remote or conceptually separated thresholds linked as ingress/egress endpoints.

hybrid_system_bridge.flow: dX/dt=F_q(X,Theta) while state remains in regime q
hybrid_system_bridge.guard: G_(q->q')(X)=0 or another declared admissibility predicate
hybrid_system_bridge.interpretation: Approaching a Door, being eligible to cross, crossing and arriving are mathematically distinct events. The guard determines when passage becomes admissible; the reset/transition defines what actually changes.
hybrid_system_bridge.false_door_test: If D maps the state back into the same attractor/regime despite an apparent exit, classify the transition as false/looping relative to the declared destination.
hybrid_system_bridge.deep_door_test: Nested transitions are modeled as composition D_n∘...∘D_1 with intermediate regimes; depth is not merely visual distance.
hybrid_system_bridge.boundary: This is the preferred scientific comparator, not a claim that theological Door events obey one universal ODE.

affordance_layer.external_comparator: Ecological psychology uses affordance language for possibilities/outcomes available in relation to an agent's capacities and environment.
affordance_layer.project_upgrade: A Door should be described by what it affords to which agent under which conditions. The same physical/social threshold can be open for one agent and closed for another.
affordance_layer.equation: Affordance(D,a,c)=possible transition set under agent a and context c
affordance_layer.epiphany: Door perception and Door existence are different. A hidden Door may exist without being perceived; a false Door may be perceived without affording the promised passage.

security_and_capability_layer.least_privilege: NIST defines least privilege as granting only the minimum authorizations/resources needed for an entity's function.
security_and_capability_layer.door_translation: A healthy Gate can protect a meaningful boundary without making all passage impossible. Access is typed rather than simply open/closed.
security_and_capability_layer.capability_neighbor: Capability-security systems use possession of authority-bearing tokens/credentials to grant specific powers. Door Pass is structurally similar as a project mechanic.
security_and_capability_layer.important_difference: A credential proves authorization inside a system; it does not prove moral worth or spiritual truth.
security_and_capability_layer.guardian_relation: Guardian protects gate conditions; shadow gatekeeper turns access control into arbitrary dependency or permanent enclosure.

knowledge_gate.recovered_logic: Specific knowledge entered at a specific Door could reveal the North Secret / Spudlight Path.
knowledge_gate.epiphany: Some Doors are epistemic: the world does not physically change first; the agent's model changes, making previously invisible action possible.
knowledge_gate.formula: knowledge gain → changed perceived affordances → newly admissible action → state transition
knowledge_gate.scientific_form: observation y -> posterior p(H|y) -> decision policy pi -> guard satisfaction -> transition D
knowledge_gate.relation_to_eye: Eye detects/measures; inference identifies affordance; Door enacts.

door_and_identity.declassification_door: role becomes former/historical rather than current
door_and_identity.restorative_door: repair/correction/reintegration changes social state without deleting history
door_and_identity.name_change_door: identity label changes while provenance remains linked
door_and_identity.court_door: allegation → adjudication / dismissal / settlement / unresolved status
door_and_identity.archive_door: current → historical / superseded / corrected / expired retrieval state

door_and_institutions.project_relation: This recovers the older claim that Door can describe borders, courts, marriage, baptism, bank loans, citizenship, initiation, intelligence classification, ports, diplomacy and technological interfaces.

boundary_science.partition: X=(X_I,X_B,X_E): internal, boundary/interface and external states
boundary_science.permeability: J=P_B Delta_mu as a generic linear flux form when domain-specific variables and units are defined
boundary_science.exit_probability: p_exit(a,c)=probability/estimated rate that a legitimate agent can discover and execute a valid exit under context c
boundary_science.portability: fraction of relevant capability/resources/data that remains usable after legitimate exit
boundary_science.critical_result: Boundary quality is not monotonic in openness. Low permeability may protect or imprison; high permeability may enable exchange or destroy privacy/safety. Function, agency, selectivity and outcome must be measured together.
boundary_science.house_shell_connection: See house-shell-boundary-permeability-model for full multiobjective boundary analysis.

door_failures.permanent_gatekeeping: gate exists primarily to preserve gatekeeper centrality
door_failures.credential_capture: pass cannot be obtained except through dependency on controlling node
door_failures.false_exit: promised escape reproduces same role/incentive structure
door_failures.infinite_deepening: every passed condition reveals another condition, making completion impossible
door_failures.opaque_denial: agent cannot discover why passage failed or what correction is possible
door_failures.identity_lock: entry exists but no legitimate exit/declassification path
door_failures.repair: publish conditions, minimize privilege, support appeal/review, preserve provenance, define reversibility and exit.

north_flag_and_distributed_gates.recovered_game_structure: Tim/North could function as Flag/source while Door appears as distributed Gate Flags throughout the world.
north_flag_and_distributed_gates.epiphany: A source does not need to be physically duplicated for its transition logic to be distributed. Many local Doors can point to one orientation protocol.
north_flag_and_distributed_gates.internet_relation: DNS, hyperlinks, APIs, credentials and replicated documentation provide real technical analogues of distributed entry points to shared resources, without implying mystical equivalence.
north_flag_and_distributed_gates.father_relation: Father/Source may be singular in project theology while Doors/manifest interfaces are plural.

deep_door_hierarchy.boundary: These levels combine recovered project game/theology material; they are not a universal religious or neurological hierarchy.

door_metrics.Accessibility: fraction of relevant agents who can discover and satisfy gate conditions
door_metrics.Transparency: degree to which conditions and denial reasons are knowable
door_metrics.Dependency: degree to which continued access requires controlling intermediary
door_metrics.FalseDoorRisk: probability perceived exit returns agent to same or worse attractor
door_metrics.CapabilityFit: match between granted authority and actual task requirements
door_metrics.ExitCost: typed cost vector for leaving a regime/system through a legitimate path
door_metrics.Portability: capability/data/resource fraction that remains usable after exit
door_metrics.TransitionInformationGain: how much the transition/knowledge gate changes justified prediction or available action, when an inference model is defined

scientific_testing_protocol.compare: A Door model should outperform a simpler continuous/no-regime model if discrete transition structure is actually needed.
scientific_testing_protocol.negative_result: If no discontinuity, guard-dependent regime change or capability transition is measurable, classify the Door as descriptive/interface metaphor rather than empirical phase transition.
scientific_testing_protocol.maturity: Empirical Door models can advance beyond T2 only when the guard/transition predicts held-out transitions or otherwise beats a declared baseline.

new_epiphanies: Door is not an object; Door is a conditional relation between states.
A key/pass does not create the destination; it changes admissibility of transition.
Knowledge can function as a portable Door because it changes perceived affordances across many environments.
A healthy House requires both walls and Doors: perfect openness is not structure, perfect closure is a shell.
False Door is the natural operator for apparent liberation that reproduces dependency.
Deep Door explains why one threshold can recursively reveal another without treating every layer as the same thing.
The mature archive should give every durable classification an explicit inverse/appeal/declassification transition where logically possible.
A scientific Door earns the name by predicting a change of regime or admissible action, not by merely being drawn as a boundary.
Boundary openness is not itself the objective; selective, transparent and repairable passage is the stronger variable.
